run_unsupervised_selection: run the unsupervised metric tool to score decoded pseudo labels against reference transcripts using WER and LM perplexity
load_tra_transcripts: load a Kaldi-style transcript file into a dictionary mapping utterance IDs to text
load_lex_lexicon: load a word-to-phoneme lexicon file into a dictionary mapping words to phoneme lists
compute_wer: compute word error rate between reference and hypothesis transcripts with optional phonemization via G2P or lexicon
compute_lm_ppl: compute language model perplexity over hypothesis transcripts using a KenLM scoring function
